links.comparator_used: Non-RAG baseline (same chatbot without retrieval, relying on model knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Hallucination rate and clinician-rated factual errors in chatbot responses
links.effect: 71.4% reduction in hallucination rate vs non-RAG baseline; clinician review of 50 responses found factual errors in 8% (4/50) of RAG-grounded outputs vs 28% (14/50) for non-RAG (Cohen κ=0.84); retrieval precision@3 of 0.88
links.quote: The RAG chatbot achieved retrieval precision@3 of 0.88 and a 71.4% reduction in hallucination rate compared with a non-RAG baseline.
